description: A fictional signal flare pistol game prop for a cave scout, chunky low-poly, one hand, held level with the wide barrel forward. One short very wide octagonal sand-grey painted barrel with a thick chamfered sand-grey muzzle rim around a big round dark bore about 40 mm across, shown closed. Along the top of the barrel one thick flat charcoal sight ridge. Under the barrel one thick charcoal frame rail running from a fat octagonal dark steel hinge block under the barrel front back to a tall blocky charcoal rear frame block behind the barrel; one small square teal lamp window in a thick raised charcoal bezel on the left flank of the frame rail. On top of the rear frame block one big dark steel hammer spur block raked back. Under the frame one large rounded-square charcoal trigger guard sized for gloves with a thick charcoal trigger, and one chunky charcoal pistol grip raked back with big diagonal ribs, one fat charcoal lanyard ring hanging from the grip base.
proportions: About 0.30 m long, 0.10 m wide and 0.26 m tall. (length : width : height = 3.00 : 1 : 2.60)
sides: only the teal lamp window is on one flank: on the LEFT flank of the charcoal frame rail under the barrel; the right flank is plain. The barrel, the sight ridge, the hinge block, the frame, the hammer spur, the trigger guard, the grip and the lanyard ring are on the centre line (symmetric left to right).
